tool.name: nf-core samblaster
tool.description: This module combines samtools and samblaster in order to use samblaster capability to filter or tag SAM files, with the advantage of maintaining both input and output in BAM format. Samblaster input must contain a sequence header: for this reason it has been piped with the "samtools view -h" command. Additional desired arguments for samtools can be passed using: options.args2 for the input bam file options.args3 for the output bam file
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ samtools view -h $args2 $bam | \\ samblaster $args | \\ samtools view $args3 -Sb - >${prefix}.bam
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": samblaster: \$( samblaster -h 2>&1 | head -n 1 | sed 's/^samblaster: Version //' ) samtools: \$(echo \$(samtools --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*samtools //; s/Using.*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
This module combines samtools and samblaster in order to use samblaster capability to filter or tag SAM files, with the advantage of maintaining both input and output in BAM format. Samblaster input must contain a sequence header: for this reason it has been piped with the "samtools view -h" command. Additional desired arguments for samtools can be passed using: options.args2 for the input bam file options.args3 for the output bam file
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: samblaster Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/samblaster ]]>
